overview: The paper identifies agreement bias in MLLM-based verifiers—a tendency to over-validate agent behavior—and proposes Self-Grounded Verification (SGV), a two-step method that first elicits task priors unconditionally from the MLLM then evaluates trajectories conditioned on those self-generated priors, demonstrating improved failure detection and downstream task performance across web navigation, computer use, and robotics benchmarks.

modules.name: Configuration & Environment Management
modules.description: Centralized management of experiment configurations, benchmark environment setup (VisualWebArena, OSWorld, robomimic), environment parallelization, proper reset logic, and VisualWebArena-Lite subset construction logic.

modules.name: Trajectory Collection & Annotation
modules.description: Data pipeline for generating and storing agent trajectories using diverse agent architectures (ReAct, UI-TARS, diffusion policy), collecting oracle labels, curating balanced success/failure subsets, and fixing oracle annotation issues (string parsing bugs, false-positive evaluators, intent mismatches).

modules.name: MLLM Verifier Baseline Implementation
modules.description: Standard MLLM-as-verifier implementation supporting interleaved screenshot-action inputs, Set-of-Marks visual grounding annotations, chain-of-thought reasoning instructions, ternary Likert scoring (SUCCESS / PARTIAL SUCCESS / FAILURE), and output parsing for rewards and feedback extraction.

modules.name: SGV First Step: Unconditional Prior Generation
modules.description: Implementation of the first SGV step that prompts the MLLM to generate broad priors about how a task is typically accomplished, conditioned only on task objective and initial state (excluding the candidate trajectory), with support for single or multiple diverse priors across model families and temperatures.

modules.name: SGV Second Step: Conditional Trajectory Verification
modules.description: Implementation of the second SGV step that performs verification conditioned on the self-generated priors from the first step, incorporating prior knowledge into the evaluation prompt while instructing the verifier to selectively use relevant prior information, producing scored evaluations and natural language feedback.

modules.name: Agreement Bias Analysis Module
modules.description: Computation of agreement bias metrics including positive bias (average reward deviation from oracle), distance skewness (dSkew), true negative rate (TNR), and analysis of output distribution concentration toward high-score regions; includes stratified analysis by trajectory success/failure status and per-template distribution visualization.

modules.name: Test-Time Scaling Integration
modules.description: Integration layer for test-time scaling techniques including chain-of-thought prompting, Set-of-Marks visual annotation, majority voting with multiple samples, and thinking/reasoning mode with configurable thinking budgets, enabling fair comparison of SGV against these baselines.

modules.name: Prompt Template Management
modules.description: Unified system managing 28+ evaluation templates spanning Likert-based scales (binary, ternary, multi-way), numeric score-based scales, range-based scales, true/false statement formats, and option-based formats; includes bias-mitigation interventions such as criteria-order randomization, label rephrasing, and scale inversion.

modules.name: Offline Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: End-to-end pipeline for evaluating MLLM verifiers on pre-collected trajectories, computing aggregate metrics (Accuracy, TPR, TNR, Bias, dSkew), stratified breakdowns by environment and trajectory length, and cross-model verification performance tables comparing baseline vs. SGV across 13+ model families.

modules.name: Self-Improvement / Reflexion Pipeline
modules.description: Iterative self-refinement loop where after each episode the verifier evaluates the trajectory, the agent generates reflections conditioned on the verifier's evaluation, and reflections are stored as memory for subsequent attempts; tracks success rate progression across refinement iterations with oracle-upper-bound comparison.

modules.name: Online Supervision Pipeline
modules.description: Real-time verifier intervention system that monitors agent execution, intervenes upon stop actions or at periodic intervals (e.g., every 5 steps), provides natural language feedback to steer agents toward backtracking or corrective actions, and supports both outcome-based and process-based verification modes for digital agents.

modules.name: Robotic Policy Steering Module
modules.description: Specialized online verification for robotic manipulation tasks, monitoring diffusion policy rollouts at regular intervals, comparing predicted task progress against actual state, and triggering replans when the trajectory is deemed off-track; integrates with robomimic environments for tool-hang task evaluation.

modules.name: Verification Metrics Computation
modules.description: Core metric calculation module implementing Accuracy, True Positive Rate (TPR), True Negative Rate (TNR), positive Bias, distance Skewness (dSkew), AUC, and task Success Rate (SR); includes confusion matrix construction for online supervision transitions (TN→Success, FP→Remain Failure, FN→Remain Success).

modules.name: Output Distribution Calibration
modules.description: Platt scaling and isotonic calibration of MLLM confidence scores; sampling-based probability estimation with empirical frequency over multiple completions; threshold optimization via Youden's J statistic; analysis of score distribution shifts pre- and post-calibration compared to SGV-induced distributions.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Comprehensive ablation engine supporting: prior diversity experiments (single vs. multi-model priors, temperature variation), grounding tool integration (web search), noisy prior injection, cross-model verifier-generator configurations, SGV step decoupling analysis, trajectory length stratification, and periodic vs. outcome-based verification comparison.

modules.name: Result Aggregation, Reporting & Visualization
modules.description: Aggregation of experiment results across runs, domains, and configurations; generation of comparison tables for offline evaluation, self-improvement, and online supervision; visualization of agreement bias distributions, performance transition Sankey diagrams, trajectory-level qualitative analysis figures, and LaTeX table output.
